title: Implement the typed M3 application-service boundary
goal: Expose a closed schema-versioned Host operation surface without creating a browser command or path gateway.
acceptanceCriteria: Every exposed operation has one V4-AD-040 class and a stable vetted identifier.
Host results bind project package Target and payload identities and reject unknown fields or operation IDs.
The first M3 surface exposes queries and previews only; apply and remote operations remain unavailable handoffs.
Focused positive and negative contract tests pass without Target or PackageRoot mutation.
risks: A generic application gateway could bypass typed root and capability validation.
decisions: Expose a closed Host-owned operation registry and no raw command transport.
